text: [100] dasayime bhikkhave dhamme appahāya abhabbo arahattaṃ sacchikātuṃ katame dasa rāgaṃ dosaṃ mohaṃ kodhaṃ upanāhaṃ makkhaṃ paḷāsaṃ issaṃ macchariyaṃ mānaṃ ime kho bhikkhave dasa dhamme appahāya abhabbo arahattaṃ sacchikātunti 1 . dasayime bhikkhave dhamme pahāya bhabbo arahattaṃ sacchikātuṃ katame dasa rāgaṃ dosaṃ mohaṃ kodhaṃ upanāhaṃ makkhaṃ paḷāsaṃ issaṃ macchariyaṃ mānaṃ ime kho bhikkhave dasa dhamme pahāya bhabbo arahattaṃ sacchikātunti . upāsakavaggo 2 pañcamo . tassuddānaṃ kāmabhogī 3 veraṃ 4 diṭṭhi vajjiyauttiyā ubho kokanudo āhuṇiyo thero upāli ābhabo 5 . dutiyapaṇṇāsako dutiyo . #1 ma. yu. itisaddo natthi . 2 po. upālivaggo . 3 po. ma. kosavedadiṭṭhiva #vappaupattiṃ gato . parakokanudo āhuṇiyo thero upāli āmenacāti . 4 ma. bhayaṃ . #vajjiyamāhitutti . 5 ma. yu. abhabbo . tatiyapaṇṇāsako samaṇasaññāvaggo paṭhamo
